info.title: copybook - read mainframe data files with a COBOL copybook
info.description: Command-line tool that converts mainframe data files to JSON Lines or CSV using a COBOL copybook. Handles EBCDIC, COMP-3, REDEFINES and OCCURS DEPENDING ON.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert a data file to JSON Lines or CSV.

options.name: --copybook
options.description: The copybook that describes the records. Required.

options.name: --to
options.description: json (default) or csv. JSON keeps groups and tables nested.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write here. Defaults to standard output.

options.name: --encoding
options.description:
Character set of the data: cp037 (default), cp1047, cp500, cp1140,
cp424, any other IBM code page number, or ascii, latin1, utf-8.

options.name: --recfm
options.description:
fixed (default), rdw (variable-length records that start with a
4-byte record descriptor word) or text (one record per line).

options.name: --record-length
options.description: Record length for fixed. Defaults to the copybook's length.

options.name: --max-record-length
options.description: The longest record to accept. Defaults to 16777216 (16 MB).

options.name: --record
options.description: Which 01-level record to use when the copybook has several.

options.name: --select
options.description:
Pick the layout per record. FIELD:VALUE=ITEM,VALUE=ITEM
decodes only ITEM, out of its REDEFINES alternatives, when FIELD
has VALUE. May be repeated.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Stop after n records.

options.name: --trim
options.description: right (default), both or none.

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Fail on the first invalid number. By default it becomes null
and is counted.

options.name: --little-endian
options.description: Binary fields are least significant byte first.

options.name: --csv-safe
options.description:
In CSV, put an apostrophe before text that a spreadsheet would run
as a formula. Use it for data you don't trust.

options.name: --float
options.description: ibm or ieee, for COMP-1 and COMP-2. Defaults to ibm for EBCDIC.
